selection: For one filing and one duration, walk that metric's tags in order. A tag with no member matches a fact with that concept, that duration, and no dimensions. A tag with a member matches a fact with that concept, that duration, that axis, and that member, and no other dimension. Use the first match. Do not sum other members to fill a hole, and do not average two facts that share a concept.
period_rule: Income-statement tags are stored for the quarter and for the year to date. A quarterly actual uses the quarter duration, whose start date is the first day of the quarter. Cash-flow tags on a 10-Q are year to date only. M1-T7 de-cumulates those into a quarter and derives Q4 from the 10-K annual amount minus Q1 through Q3. This map does not add a second tag for that arithmetic.
companyfacts_limit: The companyfacts feed for CIK 0001318605, pulled on 2026-11-04, contains us-gaap, dei, ffd, and ecd totals. It has no tsla concepts and no dimensions. Any tag with a tsla concept or a member has to be read from the filing instance. A row missing from companyfacts is not a zero.
gaps_and_tag_changes: 2021 10-K, accession 0000950170-22-000796, period 2021-01-01 to 2021-12-31: automotive sales is us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax with member us-gaap:AutomobilesMember, 44125000000. That filing has no tsla:AutomotiveSalesMember. Credits 1465000000 plus leasing 1642000000 plus that sales amount equal the AutomotiveRevenuesMember total 47232000000.

2022 10-Qs and the 2022 10-K, accession 0000950170-23-001409, replaced that member with extension concepts on srt:ProductOrServiceAxis member tsla:AutomotiveRevenuesMember: tsla:AutomotiveSalesRevenue, tsla:AutomotiveRegulatoryCredits, and tsla:AutomotiveLeasing. Full-year automotive sales revenue is 67210000000, regulatory credits 1776000000, and leasing 2476000000, which sum to automotive revenue 71462000000. Those filings declare neither tsla:AutomotiveSalesMember nor us-gaap:AutomobilesMember. The Q3 2022 10-Q, accession 0000950170-22-019867, uses the same extension concepts for the quarter 2022-07-01 to 2022-09-30.

The 2023 10-K, the 2024 10-K accession 0001628280-25-003063, and the Q3 2026 10-Q accession 0001628280-26-066775 dropped the extension concepts. Automotive sales is us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax with member tsla:AutomotiveSalesMember. 2024 full year: sales 72480000000 plus credits 2763000000 plus leasing 1827000000 equal automotive revenue 77070000000. The Q3 2026 quarter 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30: sales 20094000000, credits 113000000, leasing 353000000.
tsla:AutomotiveSales is a debit in the 2022 schema. On the 2022 full year it is 49599000000, which is neither sales revenue 67210000000 nor automotive cost 51108000000. Do not read it as either line.

Energy generation and storage is the parent member tsla:EnergyGenerationAndStorageMember. In the 2021, 2022, and 2024 10-Ks that member equals the energy sales member plus the energy leasing member. The sales-only member is not the energy line.
Cost of automotive regulatory credits is not tagged in the 2021, 2022, 2024, or Q3 2026 filings checked here. Leave it blank. Do not invent a zero.

Automotive sales cost and automotive leasing cost are separate us-gaap:CostOfRevenue members in the 2024 10-K and the Q3 2026 10-Q. The 2021 and 2022 filings report one combined automotive cost. Leave the split blank for those filings.

In the 2022 10-K, energy and services costs are us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold members, and those two amounts plus tsla:AutomotiveCostOfRevenues equal total us-gaap:CostOfRevenue. In the 2021 10-K both cost concepts are tagged and they differ, so CostOfRevenue is the one that matches the total. The config tries CostOfRevenue first.
Services gross profit has no tag. us-gaap:GrossProfit on tsla:AutomotiveSegmentMember includes services, so that member is not automotive sales and it is not services.
Free cash flow has no tag. It is quarterly operating cash flow minus quarterly purchases of property and equipment after M1-T7. Deliveries and production stay in data/manual/deliveries.csv.

total_revenue.label: Total revenue
total_revenue.when_missing: Leave total revenue blank. Do not add automotive, energy, and services.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total on the 2021, 2022, and 2024 10-Ks and the Q3 2026 10-Q.

automotive_sales.label: Automotive sales revenue
automotive_sales.when_missing: Leave automotive sales blank. Do not subtract credits and leasing from automotive revenue.

tags.filed_in: 2021 10-K, which has no AutomotiveSalesMember.

automotive_regulatory_credits.label: Automotive regulatory credits
automotive_regulatory_credits.when_missing: Leave regulatory credits blank. Do not use a revenue reversal or a terminated-contract concept.

automotive_leasing.label: Automotive leasing
automotive_leasing.when_missing: Leave automotive leasing blank. Do not add an operating-lease concept on top of a matched tag. In the 2021, 2022, and 2024 filings the matched amount is the leasing piece that ties to automotive revenue.

energy_generation_and_storage.label: Energy generation and storage
energy_generation_and_storage.when_missing: Leave energy blank. Do not substitute the energy sales member, which excludes energy leasing.

tags.filed_in: 2021, 2022, and 2024 10-Ks and the Q3 2026 10-Q. The member equals energy sales plus energy leasing.

services_and_other.label: Services and other
services_and_other.when_missing: Leave services blank. Do not use the automotive segment total, which includes services plus automotive revenue.

cost_of_revenue.label: Cost of revenues
cost_of_revenue.when_missing: Leave total cost of revenue blank. Do not add the segment costs.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total on the 2021, 2022, and 2024 10-Ks and the Q3 2026 10-Q.

cost_of_revenue_automotive.label: Automotive cost of revenues
cost_of_revenue_automotive.when_missing: Leave automotive cost blank. Do not add services cost, and do not sum sales and leasing cost to invent a total.

tags.filed_in: 2022 10-Qs and the 2022 10-K. This is the combined automotive cost.
2021 and 2024 10-Ks. Sales cost plus leasing cost, excluding services.

cost_of_revenue_automotive_sales.label: Automotive sales cost of revenues
cost_of_revenue_automotive_sales.when_missing: Leave automotive sales cost blank. The 2021 and 2022 filings report only the combined automotive cost.

cost_of_revenue_automotive_leasing.label: Automotive leasing cost of revenues
cost_of_revenue_automotive_leasing.when_missing: Leave automotive leasing cost blank. The 2021 and 2022 filings do not split it from automotive sales cost.

cost_of_revenue_energy.label: Energy generation and storage cost of revenues
cost_of_revenue_energy.when_missing: Leave energy cost blank. Do not subtract energy gross profit from energy revenue.

tags.filed_in: 2022 10-K, where CostOfRevenue has no energy member and this amount is the one that ties to total cost.

cost_of_revenue_services.label: Services and other cost of revenues
cost_of_revenue_services.when_missing: Leave services cost blank. Do not subtract a computed margin from services revenue.

tags.filed_in: 2022 10-K, where CostOfRevenue has no services member and this amount is the one that ties to total cost.

gross_profit.label: Gross profit
gross_profit.when_missing: Leave gross profit blank. Do not subtract cost from revenue.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total on the 2021, 2022, and 2024 10-Ks and the Q3 2026 10-Q.

research_and_development.label: Research and development
research_and_development.when_missing: Leave research and development blank. Do not treat it as part of SG&A.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total. Present in companyfacts and in the 2021 and 2024 10-Ks.

selling_general_and_administrative.label: Selling, general and administrative
selling_general_and_administrative.when_missing: Leave SG&A blank. Do not subtract research and development from total operating expenses.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total. Present in companyfacts and in the 2021 and 2024 10-Ks.

operating_expenses.label: Total operating expenses
operating_expenses.when_missing: Leave operating expenses blank. Do not add research and development and SG&A.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total. Present in companyfacts and in the 2021 and 2024 10-Ks.

operating_income.label: Operating income
operating_income.when_missing: Leave operating income blank. Do not subtract operating expenses from gross profit.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total. Present in companyfacts and in the 2021 and 2024 10-Ks.

net_cash_from_operating_activities.label: Net cash from operating activities
net_cash_from_operating_activities.when_missing: Leave operating cash flow blank. A 10-Q fact is year to date; M1-T7 de-cumulates it. Do not use a different concept for the quarter.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total. Annual on a 10-K and year to date on a 10-Q.

purchases_of_property_and_equipment.label: Purchases of property and equipment
purchases_of_property_and_equipment.when_missing: Leave capex blank. Do not use the solar-systems concept, and do not change the sign. The reported purchases are positive.

tags.filed_in: Consolidated total. Annual on a 10-K and year to date on a 10-Q.

free_cash_flow.label: Free cash flow
free_cash_flow.when_missing: No tag. Quarterly free cash flow is quarterly operating cash flow minus quarterly purchases of property and equipment, after M1-T7.

deliveries.label: Deliveries
deliveries.when_missing: Not an XBRL fact. Read deliveries_total from data/manual/deliveries.csv.

production.label: Production
production.when_missing: Not an XBRL fact. Read production_total from data/manual/deliveries.csv.

automotive_regulatory_credits_cost.label: Automotive regulatory credits cost
automotive_regulatory_credits_cost.when_missing: The 2021, 2022, 2024, and Q3 2026 filings checked for this map do not tag a cost for regulatory credits. Leave the quarter blank.
